premises.text: The hair industry is a $40 billion industry driven by word of mouth and is not online.
premises.evidence_span: a $40 billion industry that's driven by word of mouth. Despite the fact that social networks were built for exactly this type of industry, this industry isn't online.

premises.text: Stylists lack technology and tools to manage their businesses effectively.
premises.evidence_span: she doesn't have a website. She doesn't track client information or send marketing emails. She doesn't have daily access to her schedule because her salon doesn't have an online system.

premises.text: There are over 2 million stylists in the U.S. facing similar challenges.
premises.evidence_span: There's over 2 million Glendas in the U.S.

premises.text: Clients are actively looking for new professionals, creating a market opportunity.
premises.evidence_span: 91% of clients are either open or actively looking to find a new professional.

premises.text: StyleSeek provides stylists with their own websites and marketing tools.
premises.evidence_span: So now with StyleSeek, Glenda gets her own website.

premises.text: Clients can search for and book appointments with professionals online.
premises.evidence_span: I can go to StyleSeek.com, type in haircut, San Francisco, get a search results page with a bunch of professionals in my area.

premises.text: The platform provides stylists with insights and tools to grow their business.
premises.evidence_span: we give her key information about her business. She can set revenue goals and see how close she is to achieving them.

premises.text: StyleSeat can unlock $18 billion in inefficiency in the hair industry.
premises.evidence_span: StyleSeat will unlock $18 billion in inefficiency in the space.

value.text: Stylists gain control over their online presence and business management.
value.evidence_span: for the first time, the Internet has come to her and her world.

notes: Traction metrics and promotional offers are excluded as they do not represent premises.
